screening_rule: Require positive pooled KS and mean-fold KS deltas, and at least 2 of 3 fold wins against the original Kumo recipe; rank eligible candidates by mean-fold KS, then pooled KS. Fixed blends with original Kumo use weights 0.25 and 0.5.
confirmation_rule: Lock the chosen configuration before five-fold evaluation. Compare against baseline_e8 on the same five folds. Require positive pooled KS and mean-fold KS deltas and at least 3 of 5 fold wins.
limitation: New splits reuse the same training labels; this is a consistency check, not an untouched holdout.
new_candidates_context_policy: Use all available outer-training rows, unless the candidate explicitly samples context.
